title: 報告書とデータの言葉
label: BJT · 第4課

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 4: 25 words — reports & data.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a report on the results of a customer survey.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Subject: Results of the customer survey
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: To: All Sales Department staff
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I report the results of this customer survey as follows.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: About 60% of respondents named price as the condition they value most when buying.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: And 40% of everyone answered 'applies to me' for the item 'I feel prices are high'.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: However, looking at the products actually bought, we can see that many chose on ease of use rather than price.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The key to solving this contradiction was in the free-text answers.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: It seems customers look for low prices but in the end judge on how easy a product is to use every day.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The main point is that the numbers don't necessarily reflect people's behaviour as it is.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Furthermore, many said 'the staff member's words were polite'. The act of serving customers itself seems to be a deciding factor.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: However, results differ greatly between stores, so an analysis by region is also needed.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: For the new product people are talking about, I'd like to also interview customers in store if possible.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Based on the above, I propose training from next month to review the basics of customer service.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Note that the processing of the response data has already been requested from IT.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Kimura, Planning Department
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: reading data.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: What comes out at the end of something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The test results come out next week.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: What is required when deciding something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The condition for this job is working three days a week.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Means "the most".
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This product is the most popular.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: How things really are.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: When I actually used it, it was very handy.
lines.name: 例文

segments.meaning: to read into, grasp the meaning of

lines.en: Grasping the meaning from a text or figures.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We read the change in sales from the graph.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Fitting a condition or description exactly.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Choose the one that applies from the following.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Working something out from what you know.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We estimate next year's sales from the data.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Finding the answer to a problem.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We solved a difficult problem together.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Next: thinking & deciding.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thinking and deciding what to do.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The department manager makes the final call.
lines.name: 例文

segments.meaning: to be based on, take into account

lines.en: Basing your thinking on something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We made the plan based on customer opinions.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Asking someone for something you want.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Customers want a quick response.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Dealing with a task or problem.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll process this data by the end of today.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Being possible.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Is delivery tomorrow possible?
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The most important foundation of something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Greetings are the basics of business.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The important part.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today's talk has three key points.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: This time.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This time the meeting will be held online.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Means "on top of that", "even more".
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: On top of that, we added a new feature.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Last: people & behaviour.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A human being; people.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: People sometimes make mistakes.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Actually doing something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Don't just talk; act right away.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Something a person does by choice.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The act of helping a customer was praised.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Giving a feeling or idea a visible form.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This figure shows sales.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Not the same; different.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Customs differ from country to country.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Ordinary everyday life.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Everyday talk differs from business talk.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: What people are talking about.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This new product is getting a lot of attention.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Spoken lines, as in a drama or play.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Staff lines are set out in the manual.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 最も, the most popular.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: We made the plan ___ customer opinions.

lines.en: Question 2. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 踏まえて, based on.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 3. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 異なります, they differ.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Working something out from what you know.

lines.en: Question 4. What do you call working something out from what you know?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 推測.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 5. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 可能, possible.
lines.name: ナレーター
